title: Every Failure Is A Lesson: Utilizing All Failure Samples To Deliver Tuning-Free Efficient Yield Evaluation
problem: Yield estimation and optimization for circuit design at scaled-down technology nodes requires efficient sampling methods. Classical MNIS uses only one failure sample per iteration, limiting efficiency.
motivation: Yield estimation and optimization have become increasingly critical for circuit design as technology nodes scale down and process variability compounds.
method: EFIAL generalizes minimal norm importance sampling (MNIS) by utilizing every failure sample to construct the proposal distribution instead of just one. The approach maintains O(M) update computational complexity by leveraging the blessing of dimensionality and eliminates hyperparameter tuning. The framework is extended to the onion sampling method to significantly boost efficiency.
key_novelty: Using all failure samples rather than one to construct importance sampling proposal distributions in a completely tuning-free manner with linear computational complexity.
contributions: Generalized MNIS framework (EFIAL) that leverages all failure samples for proposal distribution construction
Tuning-free algorithm with O(M) update complexity scaling with number of failures
Extension to onion sampling achieving up to 9.08x speedup over baseline method
Demonstrated up to 13.54x speedup and 24.91% accuracy improvement over SOTA yield estimation methods

metrics.speedup: 13.54x (5.16x average) vs SOTA; 9.08x (4.68x average) vs onion sampling

primary_theme: Efficient tuning-free yield estimation via comprehensive failure sample utilization
